Senior Backend Engineer — Example Freight (fictional)

About us
Example Freight moves parcels across Europe. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team.

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional backend development experience
- Strong experience with Kubernetes in production
- PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning
- Experience building event-driven systems with Apache Kafka
- English at C1 level or above
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

Nice to have
- Terraform
- Experience with gRPC

Location: remote within the EU. Applicants must be eligible to work in the EU.
Apply at jobs@example.com
